title: 거기도 비가 올까
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Ballad. A clean acoustic guitar plays arpeggiated chords in the intro and verses. A grand piano enters with sustained chords and melodic fills. A baritone male vocalist sings with a breathy, emotive delivery, transitioning into a powerful chest voice in the higher register. Orchestral strings provide legato accompaniment. The bass guitar plays melodic lines with a warm, rounded tone. Drums enter with a soft kick and a crisp snare. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, in the key of E Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[arpeggiated acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
피어나는 사거리에서면 [piano enters]
열정 갈림길이 보여
표지판의 글씨는 번졌지만 [strings enter]
두 갈래 무게는 선명해
구두 뒤축이 [bass enters]
다른 만큼
걸어온 이력이 있는 거야
왼쪽을 택한 그 저녁 [drums enter]
